name: When should I consider an accessible kitchen layout update?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider an accessible kitchen layout update?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider an accessible kitchen layout update if you or a family member has a current or anticipated mobility challenge, or if you plan to age in place in your home. It's also beneficial if you frequently host guests with diverse needs. Updating proactively can enhance safety, convenience, and long-term usability, improving daily living for everyone in the household.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider an update if you or a family member has mobility challenges, plan to age in place, or host guests with diverse needs. Proactive updates enhance safety and usability.
